Chapter 935: Chapter 3 Martial Tao Rankings (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 935: Chapter 3 Martial Tao Rankings (Subscribe Please)

The speed at which the thoughts of Xia Qin Supreme Being ran was truly swift, as he immediately uncovered the crux of the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter—

Rule Models.

Within the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter, a vast number of rule models are contained, all of which are quite different from the many rule models compiled by human civilization.

One must know,

To establish and perfect a rule model requires the expenditure of an unknown number of evolution scholars’ efforts.

Moreover, some rule models are not something that can be established as soon as one wishes to do so.

Which one of the rule models compiled by human civilization isn’t the result of generation after generation of evolution scholars’ relentless endeavors?

But now?

Xia Qin Supreme Being has discovered a plethora of entirely new rule models within the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter.

Entirely new rule models?

A multitude?

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s heart was filled with doubt and amazement, and he immediately began to delve into every rule model included in the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter.

The other eight human Supreme Beings did the same, focusing most of their minds on the rule models.

“Is this the rule model for the Infinite Space Rule? Such Pillar-level Fusion Rules are mastered by so few evolutionaries in our human civilization, yet a rule model has already been created?”

“And look at this rule model, the Great Destruction Thunderbolt Rule model? The fusion of the Great Destruction Rule and the Thunderbolt Rule? The Great Destruction Rule itself is already a Pillar-level Fusion Rule, and now fused with the Thunderbolt Rule? A rule model for this too?”

“The Rule of Time Shadow model? The model is no problem, but how did the Galaxy Master create these rule models?”

…

As their understanding deepened, a storm of shock and awe swiftly arose in the hearts of the nine human Supreme Beings.

For the establishment and perfection of a rule model, it primarily requires an ultimate understanding of the corresponding rule.

Otherwise, not to mention establishing a rule model, one cannot even fully comprehend that kind of rule.

Furthermore, the rule models that are established and perfected must possess ‘dissemination standard.’

An evolutionary scholar who has just penetrated the Rule of Time, with some cost, indeed can establish a complete Rule of Time model.

However, this kind of Rule of Time model is only applicable to this evolution scholar, and it won’t be of any help to other evolutionaries’ understanding of their own Rule of Time by contemplating this model.

No matter which rule, they are all boundless.

Even the most basic Golden Rules, when fully understood by different evolutionaries, what they grasp of the Golden Rules is in fact inconsistent.

It’s merely different aspects of the Golden Rules.

Rule models stem from summarizing the corresponding rules, the more aspects they encompass, the broader their dissemination standard.

But as easy as it is to say, it is incredibly difficult to achieve.

However.

As the nine human Supreme Beings continually inspected rule models within the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter, they astonishingly found that the dissemination standard of these rule models was unbelievably high, fully reaching the level that they could be completely spread amongst all evolutionary beings in human civilization.

But how is this possible?

Just the rule models seen by the nine Supreme Beings correspond to thousands of rules.

The Galaxy Master could only hope to establish the corresponding rule models after elevating these rules to the ultimate understanding.

Just thousands of rules? And all at least Pillar-level Fusion Rules? Understanding all elevated to the ultimate?

The nine Supreme Beings were somewhat dumbfounded for a moment; they hadn’t reached such a level of rule comprehension.

“The rule model for the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.”

Just then, Xia Qin Supreme Being’s mind was shaken because he saw the core section of the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter.

That was the rule model corresponding to the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

The most important rule in the eleventh layer of any evolutionary path, including the path of the Supreme Evolution, is the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

Other Pillar-level Fusion Rules, you may choose to comprehend or not to comprehend.

Just like breaking through from the tenth layer to the eleventh, one only needs to elevate a Pillar-level Fusion Rule to the Second Realm.

There’s no specification as to which Pillar-level Fusion Rule it must be.

But the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule? To progress in the eleventh layer, one needs to understand the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

Time and space are the two cornerstones of all rules, and the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is even more so.

Simply put, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is a ‘mandatory option’ for every evolutionist who reaches the eleventh layer.

“The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule models from the First Realm to the Fifth Realm?”

“Thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three rule models?”

“These rule models…”

It took the nine Supreme Beings over an hour to finish reading the more than thirty thousand rule models corresponding to the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

It’s not that the nine Supreme Beings couldn’t understand them; anyone who steps into the twelfth layer has already reached the Sixth Realm in terms of spatiotemporal comprehension.

However, determining whether a rule model for a certain rule meets the dissemination standard requires not just an understanding of that part of the rule’s essence that one comprehends, but also involves reviewing the other aspects.

And since the rule model for the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule is of great importance, as the Supreme Beings of human civilization, they naturally felt more reassured after reviewing it several times.

“The rule model for the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule has a high dissemination standard, reaching the level required for widespread propagation.”

After a while, the Ancient Power Supreme Being spoke up, his tone unconsciously revealing disbelief.

Before seeing the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule model, they were both expectant and apprehensive in their hearts.

But after confirmation, they were somewhat in disbelief.

If it were said that the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule model originated from the hands of Xuanyuan Supreme, the other eight human Supreme Beings could reluctantly accept it.

After all, the stature of Xuanyuan Supreme is evident.

He is the strongest of the human civilization’s Supreme Beings, with power close to the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.
